name: Ma o Jutaiseshi Otome no Kuetsu 2
original_name: 魔ヲ受胎セシ処女ノ苦悦2
source:
Maya, a monster eliminator, fights against monsters every day. One day, she loses a battle against them and has sex with them...

However, there is nothing wrong with her body, so she thinks it was just a dream. But an irresistible sexual impulse suddenly arises inside her body... She tries hide it, but it gets stronger and stronger...

Well, what will happen to Maya...? 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
玛雅是一名怪物消灭者，每天都与怪物战斗。有一天，她输掉了一场与他们的战斗并与他们发生了性关系……

但她的身体并没有任何问题，所以她认为这只是一个梦。但她体内却突然升起一股难以抗拒的性冲动……她试图隐藏，却越来越强烈……

好吧，玛雅会发生什么……？

[来自工口游戏商店]
